name: Bandit
notes: Hungry, ragged, and watching the road.
Wants your money, not a fight. Runs if the leader goes down.

name: Wolf
notes: Lean and patient. Circles before it closes in.
Hunts in packs. Six or more fight as a crowd.

name: Tunnel Sneak
notes: A small, sly thief that lives underground.
Avoids a fair fight. Loves special items and will trade secrets for them.
*Critical damage:* the spear tip snaps off in the wound. The victim cannot run until it is removed.

name: Cultist
notes: Robed and soft-spoken, with a hidden face.
Will not fight alone. Sends others first.
*Critical damage:* drains the victim's will. They lose 1d4 Willpower.

name: Guardian
alsoKnownAs: a stone statue, or a security robot
notes: Set to protect one place. It never leaves its post.
Cannot be frightened or bribed. Can be tricked.

name: Brute
alsoKnownAs: a troll, a mutant, a hulking alien
attack: claws (d8+d8: roll both, use the higher)
notes: Huge, foul-smelling, and always hungry.
Can spend its turn to regain all of its lost HP. It must be finished off quickly.
*Critical damage:* the wound festers. The victim is deprived until it is cleaned with fire.

name: Raptor
notes: Fast, clever, and never alone.
One holds your attention while the others come from the sides.

name: Sky Terror
alsoKnownAs: a flying dinosaur, a giant bat, a small dragon
notes: A huge shadow that drops from above.
Dives, strikes, and climbs out of reach. It can only be hit with ranged attacks, unless it is brought to the ground.
*Critical damage:* it carries the victim into the air.

name: Trooper
notes: Armored, trained, and following orders.
Fights from cover and calls for backup.

name: Corrupted Hound
notes: A hunting beast remade by something evil. Bone shows through its hide.
Tracks anyone who has used an Ability in the last hour, and is not fooled by hiding.
*Critical damage:* the victim catches lasting corruption.
